Fat-prompt state, visual model, and byte templates.

This module owns the policy for prompt chrome: prompt rows, token bar, thinking ticker state, spacing, receipts, and the visual frame model used by tests. It may construct ANSI byte templates for those prompt frames, but it does not write them. terminal.nim is the only module that serializes those bytes to the terminal.
